description: Ballads and banners - a battle bard whose songs carry the whole party.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 42 real CoA Inspiration talents (role Support). More than twenty are party or raid auras, and a talent effect or proc payload can never reach an ally - but a party ABILITY can. The Guardian's four ally-facing abilities (Song of Steel, Inspiring Presence, Standard of Valiance, Champion's Presence) had all been authored as target_type 'self', so the support spec supported nobody; Kyle's call was to convert them to 'party' rather than build a selfish Inspiration. This tree empowers those four auras. Dead keys it wanted: energy_regen, energy_regen_pct, resource_regen_pct - no per-turn resource regeneration key exists at all.

nodes.name: A Hero's Tale
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your songs and presences by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Energy regeneration by 10%.' THERE IS NO RESOURCE REGENERATION KEY - energy_regen, energy_regen_pct and resource_regen_pct are all read by nothing. Rerouted to the cost of the four party auras, which is what more Energy buys a support: the auras up more often. POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Leading the March
nodes.description: Increases your attack power and armour by 8%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your attack power and total Armor by 4%.' Doubled for the two ranks and authored as the full-investment ceiling. Both keys take percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Dragonslayer
nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 5%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your Agility by 5%.' Percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: War's Muse
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your critical damage by 20%.' Routed to the physical side, which is every ability this spec uses. crit_damage_physical is a FRACTION, while crit_chance_physical beside it is a PERCENT.

nodes.name: Spirit of Battle
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit with all attacks by 3%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1% for you and party and raid members. Does not stack with similar effects.' A TALENT cannot reach an ally even now that the spec has party abilities - get_talent_effects() reads only the character's own trees - so the hit lands on the Guardian and the description says 'your'. Priced at 3% rather than CoA's 1%, since it covers one character instead of five.

nodes.name: Battle Bard
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Ballads by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of your Ballads by 15%.' CoA's Inspiring Leader node transforms Pulverize and Broad Sweep into Ballads, which no key does - nothing replaces one ability with another - so 'Ballads' is read as the two songs Frontier actually has: Ballad of Steel (enemy damage) and Song of Battle (enemy_aoe dot).

nodes.name: Soundwave
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Sound of War by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim. Sound of War is an enemy_aoe ability in Frontier rather than CoA's triggered event, which is why five talents in this tree hang off its cast instead of off 'triggering' it.

nodes.name: Powerful Voice
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ballads by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim. ability_*_crit is a PERCENT, unlike ability_*_crit_damage, which is a FRACTION - both appear in this tree.

nodes.name: Veteran of the Third War
nodes.description: Blocking an attack restores some of your health.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'You now restore 3% of your base health whenever you block an attack.' on_block is a live trigger and heal_flat a live payload, so this ports in shape. The amount is flat because no payload reads a percentage of maximum health - the same limit that made the Witch Doctor's Spiritual Devotee a flat mana grant.

nodes.name: Minstrel
nodes.description: Casting a Ballad quickens you, raising your haste by 3% per stack for 3 turns, stacking 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting a Ballad now increases your haste by 3%, stacking 3 times, for 8 sec.' PORTS EXACTLY - CoA's 3%, 3 stacks, and 8 sec is 3 turns. One of the few nodes in this spec that needed no translation at all, because it is the one that buffs only the Guardian.

nodes.name: Into The Fray
nodes.description: Sound of War carries you forward, granting an extra attack once per turn.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Triggering a Sound of War now grants you an additional auto attack on your next swing.' extra_attack is a live boolean payload. CoA treats Sound of War as a triggered event with its own hooks; Frontier has it as an enemy_aoe ability, so this fires on the cast. 1-turn internal cooldown so a multi-target cast does not grant several extra attacks.

nodes.name: Pied Piper
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ram by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Triggering a Sound of War now increases damage of your next Ram by 20% for 15 sec.' No payload empowers a 'next' specific cast - the same wall as the Witch Doctor's Sen'jin's Presence and Dambala's Lethality - so CoA's 20% is permanent. Stronger than CoA's, stated rather than hidden.

nodes.name: Knight's Song
nodes.description: Your Song of Steel rings a turn longer and raises your armour by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting a Ballad now grants allies Knight's Song. Emanate an aura for 10 seconds that increases the Armor of party and raid members by 400.' A proc cannot apply an effect to allies, so the armour aura cannot be created from a talent. But Song of Steel IS now a party ability, so extending its duration is a real party benefit - the longest lever a talent has on an ally. The armour itself lands on the Guardian. The small integer duration keeps this node out of the rank policy's reach.

nodes.name: Dissonance
nodes.description: Sound of War has a 25% chance to leave enemies taking 5% more magic damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Sound of War now has a 25% chance to reduce enemies' resistances by 75 and increases their Magic damage taken by -2% for 8 seconds.' CoA's 25% kept and 8 sec is 3 turns. The flat resistance reduction has no key, so it is folded into the magic damage taken, raised to 5% to cover both halves. INSIDE A STATUS EFFECT magic_damage_taken_pct is divided by 100 and POSITIVE INCREASES damage taken - so a debuff is positive here, the opposite sign to the same key as a talent effect, where negative reduces. CoA's own '-2%' is written as a reduction but described as an increase; the increase is what a support wants.

nodes.name: Banner of Conquest
nodes.description: Your Champion's Presence lasts a turn longer, and your critical strike chance rises by 5%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Attach a Banner of Conquest to your back, increasing the critical strike chance of party and raid members within 40 yds by 5%. Does not stack with similar effects.' A wearable banner is not a mechanic here and a talent cannot give allies crit. Champion's Presence is now a party ability, so its duration is the real party lever; the 5% crit lands on the Guardian at CoA's own number.

nodes.name: Banner of Swiftness
nodes.description: Your Song of Steel lasts a turn longer, and your haste rises by 5%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Attach a Banner of Swiftness to your back, increasing the haste of party and raid members within 40 yds by 5%.' Same treatment as Banner of Conquest above. CoA's Banner Boy node ('+5% haste and +8% to Line Formation's movement speed') is folded in here, its movement half dropped - there is no positioning in this engine.

nodes.name: Reverberations
nodes.description: Ram sets the air ringing, dealing magic damage over 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Ram now causes your next 3 melee attacks to deal an additional 30 + 10% AP Magic damage for 10 seconds.' No charge counter exists and no payload empowers the next N attacks, so the extra magic damage is paid as a dot on the target instead - the same total, over turns. CoA's 'Magic' is typed arcane, the engine's generic magic school.

nodes.name: Elegant Combat
nodes.description: Casting a Ballad has a 20% chance to ready Ram again.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting a Ballad has a 20% chance to remove the cost of the next Ram and increase its critical chance by 10%.' Neither a free next cast nor a one-shot crit bonus is expressible, so the 20% buys a full cooldown reset instead - reset_cooldown as a BARE LIST - which is worth more than a free cast and is the honest nearest thing. CoA's 20% kept.

nodes.name: Stand Your Ground!
nodes.description: Your Standard of Valiance stands a turn longer, and you take 10% less physical damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'While standing in your Standard of Valiance, your allies' Physical damage taken is reduced by 10%.' THIS IS THE NODE THAT MOST NEEDED THE PARTY CONVERSION: Standard of Valiance already carries physical_damage_taken_pct -12 in its own stat_mods, and now that it targets the party, that mitigation reaches allies - so extending its duration delivers exactly what CoA promises. The 10% on this node is the Guardian's own share. AS A TALENT EFFECT physical_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION where NEGATIVE reduces; inside a status effect it is divided by 100 and positive increases.

nodes.name: Warbringer's Manuscript
nodes.description: Your critical strikes bring Hero's March a turn closer to ready.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Critical strikes now reduce the cooldown of Hero's March by -1 sec.' Ports in shape; 1 sec becomes a turn, which is a buff relative to CoA because a fraction of a turn cannot be expressed, so a 1-turn internal cooldown holds it to once per turn.

nodes.name: Bard's Manuscript
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Hero's March by 40%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces the cooldown of Hero's March by -60 sec.' Expressed as a percentage because CoA's 60 seconds is measured against a 2-minute cooldown that does not exist here in those units. POSITIVE reduces, so CoA's minus sign is dropped.

nodes.name: Echoes of War
nodes.description: Sound of War echoes, striking again for magic damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Triggering a Sound of War now grants Echoes of War to nearby allies for 8 sec. Next direct ability or spell deals 15% of their damage as additional Magic Damage.' A proc cannot apply an effect to allies and nothing empowers an ally's next cast, so the ally-facing half is impossible. Built as the Guardian's own echo - CoA's extra magic damage, dealt directly. damage_flat with a school is a live payload.

nodes.name: Legion Commander
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Harrowing Melody by 50% and of your Ballads by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'The damage increase of Harrowing Melody now affects an additional 2 Ballad casts and guarantees them to critically strike and deal 100% more damage.' A GUARANTEED CRIT HAS NO KEY - crit at 100 would be a permanent stat, not a one-shot - and 'an additional 2 casts' needs a charge counter. Both halves are paid as flat damage on the abilities involved, which is what the combination delivered.

nodes.name: War Drums
nodes.description: Sound of War has a 40% chance to beat twice, striking again for magic damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Adds 5% to the value of Echoes of War. In addition, performing a Sound of War now has a 40% chance to echo, striking an additional time after 0.5 sec. Can only occur once per sec.' The second half ports - CoA's 40%, and the 1-turn internal cooldown covers 'once per sec'. The first half would need a talent to edit another talent's payload, which no key does, so it is folded into this node's own damage. Deliberately stacks with Echoes of War at tier 4, as CoA's do.

nodes.name: Field Commander
nodes.description: Your Song of Steel and Inspiring Presence each last a turn longer, and all your damage rises by 8%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Placing a Standard causes your next Song of Steel to unleash an additional unique effect. Spellwarding... Might... Rallying... Recovery...' A random or chosen pick from a table of four party auras is not expressible: apply_effect takes one effect or a list but nothing chooses among them, and a talent cannot reach an ally regardless. Rebuilt as duration on the two party auras CoA names here plus the Guardian's own damage. The small integer durations keep this node out of the rank policy.

nodes.name: Inspiring Presence
nodes.description: Your presences and standards all last a turn longer, and your attack power rises by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Emanate an aura around you for 15 seconds, causing allied players within 100 yds to deal 35% AP additional damage as Holy damage when they deal direct damage. Applies Exhaustion, preventing you from benefiting from similar effects for 1 minute.' The ally damage rider cannot be created by a talent. THE CAPSTONE IS THE PAYOFF OF THE PARTY CONVERSION: a turn on all four party auras at once, which on a support is four party-wide buffs held a third longer - attack power from Song of Steel, crit from Inspiring Presence, physical mitigation from Standard of Valiance and haste from Champion's Presence. That is a real support capstone rather than a self-buff, which it could not have been before those four abilities were converted. Exhaustion has no mechanism and is dropped. CoA's Voice of an Angel node (reset Liberation, Harrowing Melody and Hero's March) is not built - Frontier already has that as an ability, and a talent resetting three cooldowns at once needs an active, not a passive.
